learning_outcomes.text: Ability to know, understand and use the principles of multidimensional differential calculus, integral calculus in several variables, differential equations and Laplace transform.

syllabus_topics: Surface integral. Gauss's and Stokes' Theorems
Systems of linear ordinary differential equations
assessment_rules: Students can pass the course through the Progressive Evaluation system. If not successful or chosen as an alternative, students may take the Final Global Exam. In the Progressive Evaluation system, the components are Continuous assessment in class (maximum 10%), First partial exam (minimum 30%), and Second partial exam (minimum 60%). For students who take the Final Global Exam, their final grade will be 100% based on this exam. A 'Not Presented' grade is given only to students who have not taken the First partial exam, Second partial exam, or Final Global Exam. The Extraordinary Call evaluation is based on a single exam with 100% weight.
